findings.description: Operator-directive discovery sorts by d.issued_at descending as the priority tiebreak, but directive files use filed_at (not issued_at). All 15 pending directives have undefined issued_at, so the tiebreak collapses to readdir order (effectively oldest-filename-first / FIFO). Harmless today (FIFO is acceptable) but the date-priority intent is silently dead.
findings.recommendation: Change the dispatcher node snippet in tinker.md to read d.issued_at||d.filed_at||'' for the tiebreak. One-line fix; candidate for a Mode 4 self-fix next run.
